name: Beermoney Productivity Toolbox for WooCommerce
author: beermoneycoding

sections.description:
Beermoney Productivity Toolbox for WooCommerce is a lightweight collection of small WooCommerce-focused productivity apps under one dashboard.

The plugin is designed for store owners, administrators, and shop managers who want practical tools for everyday store maintenance tasks. Individual apps can be enabled or disabled from the Beermoney dashboard.

Included workflows cover product editing, stock review, order-note visibility, image and ALT-text maintenance, SKU redirects, backorder notices, email image compatibility fixes, and cleanup tasks.

The plugin stores its own settings in the WordPress database. It does not add front-end advertising, tracking, remote code loading, or customer-facing paid features.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it from the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Open the Beermoney dashboard in wp-admin and enable the apps you want to use.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. Beermoney Productivity Toolbox for WooCommerce is built for WooCommerce stores and requires WooCommerce.

Does the plugin collect personal data?

The core plugin does not collect personal data from store visitors.

Some app functions may process existing WooCommerce or WordPress data inside the site admin area, such as product data, order notes, image metadata, and plugin settings. This data remains on the site unless the site owner exports or deletes it using normal WordPress/WooCommerce workflows.

Can individual apps be enabled or disabled?

Yes. Apps can be enabled or disabled from the Beermoney dashboard.

Is this an official WooCommerce plugin?

No. Beermoney Productivity Toolbox for WooCommerce is an independent plugin and is not affiliated with or endorsed by WooCommerce.
